scientific_question: Does the GRL/vendor-adversarial branch change localization performance when normalization, sampling, architecture, optimization, seeds, checkpoint selection, and evaluation are strictly matched?
analysis_status: post-submission revision experiment; exploratory with respect to previously accessed outer-test data

shared_training_contract.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation pFROC; exact ties retain earlier epoch

normalization_contract.fit_scope: labeled optimization cases plus all eligible unlabeled cases, matching the historical vendor-adversarial strategy

statistics.primary_test: two-sided exact sign-flip test on five fold-level mean differences after averaging five repeats within each fold
statistics.run_level_results: descriptive only; not treated as independent clinical samples
statistics.effect_reporting: mean paired difference with fold-level values and descriptive 95% bootstrap interval if case-level predictions are available
statistics.multiplicity: none; this is one reviewer-requested contrast

optional_secondary_postlock_outertest.interpretation: exploratory because the original outer test has already been accessed

failure_policy: retain and document every failed run; no performance-based deletion or replacement
claim_rule: Existing vendor-vs-pure results cannot be causally attributed to GRL. Any GRL statement in the revision must follow this matched contrast and remain dataset-specific.
